has a short summary, a picture, a **Do it** task and one set of questions.
The full explanations, examples and exercises are in the notes.

## Key terms

{{< glossary open-asset asset-library licence creative-commons royalty-free attribution tasl credits-screen credits-file permissive-licence copyleft open-font-licence >}}

## 25.1 Where can assets come from?

- **Own work**, **open asset sites**, **paid libraries**, **public
  domain**, **freelancers**.
- Keep the proof: the licence page, the receipt, the contract.
- An image search is not a source.

![Where assets can come from.](images/asset-sources.png){width=94%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Download from the creator's page or a known library, not a re-upload.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Find two assets"}
Find a sound and an image you may use in a game for sale; write the site
and the licence.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · Sources and proofs"}
Choose the proof to keep.

::: {.match extra="a screenshot of a search|nothing"}
a sound from an open sound site
:   the saved licence page

music from a freelancer
:   the signed contract

a sprite pack bought in a store
:   the receipt and the licence

art drawn by an employee
:   nothing extra (work for hire)
:::
:::

## 25.2 Read and save the licence

- Check the **author**, the **exact licence**, **commercial use** and
  **changes**, the **credit**, **other limits**.
- Save the page as a PDF with the date.

![Reading a licence page.](images/licence-page.png){width=94%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
"Free" can mean free of cost, not free to use in a game for sale.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Read a licence page"}
Answer the five questions for one of your assets and save its page.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · Night Rain"}
Read the licence page. Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="the website|no"}
the author
:   Lina Haddad

the licence
:   CC BY 4.0

commercial use and changes
:   allowed

selling the sound file alone
:   not allowed
:::
:::

## 25.3 Credits with TASL

- **T**itle, **A**uthor, **S**ource, **L**icence (+ the changes).
- In the **credits screen** and the **credits file**.

![A credit with TASL.](images/tasl.png){width=94%}

![Credits screen and credits file.](images/credits.png){width=94%}

{{< sim file="sims/credit-builder.html" poster="sims/credit-builder.png" title="Credit Builder: TASL for Rooftop Rescue" height="720" >}}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
"Sounds from the Internet" is not a credit.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Your credits file"}
In **Credit Builder**, build the three credits; start a credits file for
your two assets.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · TASL"}
Use Credit Builder. Choose the part of the credit.

::: {.match extra="the file size|the price"}
"Night Rain"
:   the title

Lina Haddad
:   the author

sounds.example.org/night-rain
:   the source

CC BY 4.0
:   the licence
:::
:::

## 25.4 Code, fonts and tools

- **Permissive** (MIT, BSD): keep the notice.
- **Copyleft** (GPL, CC BY-SA): share changes under the same licence.
- **OFL fonts:** embed for free; do not sell the font alone.
- **Engines and tools:** read the terms.

![Code, fonts and tools.](images/code-font-licences.png){width=94%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Fonts and code libraries have authors and licences too.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Code and fonts"}
Find an open font and an open-source library; write their licences and
conditions.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 4 · Licences"}
Choose the licence.

::: {.match extra="all rights reserved|CC BY-NC"}
keep the copyright notice with the code
:   MIT

changed versions under the same licence
:   copyleft (GPL, CC BY-SA)

embed in a game, not sell alone
:   SIL OFL

no conditions at all
:   CC0
:::
:::

## Game challenge: Asset Shopping {.challenge}

Work alone. Use every section of today.

Six assets: a **thunder sound** (CC BY), **cloud sprites** (CC0), a **cat
sprite** for non-commercial use, **roof tiles** (CC BY-SA) to recolour, a
**pixel font** (OFL) and a **physics library** (MIT).

{{< sim file="sims/asset-shopping.html" poster="sims/asset-shopping.png" title="Asset Shopping: six assets for a game for sale" kind="game" height="520" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 5 · The shopping list"}
Choose what Night Owl must do.

::: {.match extra="sell the file|hide the credit"}
the thunder sound, CC BY
:   use it with a TASL credit

the cat sprite, non-commercial only
:   do not use it in a game for sale

the recoloured roof tiles, CC BY-SA
:   share the changes under CC BY-SA

the physics library, MIT
:   keep its copyright notice
:::
:::

## Summary {.summary}

- Assets come from own work, open sites, paid libraries, the public domain
  and freelancers.
- Read the licence page and save it.
- Credit every asset with TASL in the credits screen and the credits file.
- Code and fonts have licences: MIT, GPL, OFL.
- Keep every proof in the project.
